title: Borrow pass as a left-to-right fold
statement: For every incoming carry bit $c$ and finite bit word $b$, folding the one-bit borrow rule from left to right over $b$, starting in state $c$, returns the same final state and rewritten word as the borrow pass on $b$ starting with $c$.
replaced:
For every carry flag and every bit word, folding the one-bit borrow transducer over
the word is precisely the fixed-width borrow pass on that word.
